description: All scheduled unlocks in the next 60 days for one token, with recipients (team, investors, treasury ...), USD value, share of circulating supply, futures availability and a link to the token page. Accepts a ticker (ARB), a name (Arbitrum) or a slug (arbitrum). Returns found=0 if the token has no unlock in the next 60 days (that is not an error). If the result mentions onchain_check, call get_onchain_check to see what the locked wallets are doing. lang=ru returns Russian page links.
name: get_token_unlocks
title: Unlocks for one token
